name: Panamera Holdings Corporation
summary: Panamera Holdings Corporation is a publicly traded environmental services and technology company that brings together deep expertise in metals recycling, clean energy production, and carbon-based materials innovation. Leveraging a proprietary portfolio spanning recycled metals, domestically sourced critical earth materials, and on-demand clean power, Panamera integrates recycling, manufacturing, and breakthrough energy solutions to reduce landfill waste and energy inefficiencies. The company was formerly known as Panamera Healthcare Corporation and changed its name in October 2021.
